Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. This effect reads "you may play," so if you perform the conditions specified for "by X," you may choose whether or not to activate the effect shown in text.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to place [Doomsday Clock] from my hand or trash as a digivolution card, can I choose to not play [Diaboromon] Tokens?

Card Q&A.a:
No, it doesn't. You can play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens, but they are played at the same time during a single timing, therefore the effect only triggers once.
